conclusion: No preset-specific RTL/verification/physical-flow/retrieval shortcut found in inspected main or R15 ordinary live production paths. Presets and arbitrary spec use the same live pipeline. Explicit disclosed supplied-starter and recorded-replay paths remain, so do not claim every path is model-generated or every handwritten source path was removed.

findings.detail: Selecting a preset changes editor spec_text and attached preset_id. Editing text clears preset selection. API only validates ID membership, stores caller spec_text and metadata. Worker never forwards preset_id to the generator; live generator/EDA/LLM/packaging/Worker preset grep has zero matches in both roots.
findings.topic: Presets are UI/spec input plus metadata

findings.classification: same live route for preset and arbitrary spec
findings.detail: Both live inputs use store run.spec_text/targets, same ToolRunner and Orchestrator. General scope then SPEC/RTL/VERIFY/repair/synthesis/flow/optimization/signoff/package; tools snapshot actual work/src and work/test and package selected flow. No preset key reaches these stages. R15 worker line positions differ only due guard wiring.

findings.classification: intentional disclosed handwritten RTL path, not automatic preset exception
findings.detail: starter_id is independent optional UART literal, default None. Only explicit starter_id loads provenance-hashed supplied source, freezes required ports, emits model_generated=False/supplied faulty origin, writes starter then actual lint/independent tests/repair. No automatic preset-name trigger. Actual starter RTL/provenance/test payloads were not opened by this audit.

findings.classification: explicit recorded playback, not live inference/flow claim
findings.detail: POST/api/replays validates hash-bound recording; is_replay worker branch occurs before create_llm; playback emits source event IDs and REPLAY/no new model or EDA notice. Main live endpoint cannot silently select recording by preset/spec.

findings.classification: health, report display, generic diagnostics/helper counters, R15 protection
findings.detail: Golden marker is health-only; parser doc cites format, EDA default golden is a run label while ToolRunner passes real run_id. Failure label describes a category; report case IDs are read-only sealed aggregate projection. R15 eval namespace strings perform metadata protection, not design retrieval. Core routing/tools/prompts/scope have zero eval/golden/case lookup matches.
findings.topic: Golden/eval/case matches are isolated from generation

findings.detail: Exact retained prompt query has zero matches in both roots for public preset words, corpus paths, hidden/golden/case_id or timestamp-style trial IDs. General product defaults and protocol/external-reference policy apply to all requests. Explicit starter-only contract is separately disclosed, not included as a general prompt example.
findings.topic: Prompts contain no preset IDs or evaluation-path/trial patterns searched

limits: Current static source audit, not historical proof of deletion, runtime qualification, arbitrary-spec success guarantee or reliability score.
Keyword searches and followed source paths cannot prove absence of all imaginable semantic special cases. No corpus comparison was performed, deliberately.
The explicit supplied starter injects handwritten RTL; keep this exception and replay disclosure visible rather than claiming all demo paths are generated.
Named public-source maps were stable at recorded collection/focused-check points, not continuous or loaded-code proof.

scope.excluded: No corpus, golden/oracle/heldout files, test payloads, recordings payloads, generated source, actual environment or credentials opened. Only public preset IDs/names projected from designs/presets.json.
scope.operations: Read-only source review, exact ripgrep commands/matches, opaque public-source SHA maps; no app imports, model/provider/EDA/services/tests or source changes.
